svg.title: Agentic AI engineering with Claude Code, custom MCP servers, sub-agents and skills, plus six certifications
svg.desc: Control schematic: a skill-driven agent loop (brainstorm and plan, code with Copilot, TDD and verify, human review) around Claude Code and its sub-agents, connected over an MCP bus to the codebase, tools and data. General notes: Superpowers skills run the loop (brainstorm, plan, TDD, verify, review); custom MCP servers and sub-agents reach code, tools and data; Ponytail keeps diffs minimal and Caveman keeps output token-lean; a human approves every PR. Certifications shown as plain text inspection tags: Claude Code in Action, Introduction to Model Context Protocol and Claude 101 (Anthropic, Aug 2026); AZ-204 Azure Developer Associate, AI-900 and AZ-900 (Microsoft).
svg.text: Claude Code + custom MCP servers + sub-agents + skills, with TDD and human review in the loop
plain text tiles · no issuer logos
